name: Memoriae Mori
source:
Faceless corpses are being found in the city. Although two of the victims were students, their families didn't seem to be very upset. This catches the main character's attention, but her focus soon turns to those around her: a foreigner who suddenly transfers to her school, her sister who starts acting strangely, and a mysterious girl she encounters. While the main character tries to manage her personal life, in the city, people continue to die.

[From [url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=29&t=41308]Lemmasoft forum[/url]]
translation:
城市中不断发现无名尸体。虽然其中两名受害者是学生，但他们的家人似乎并没有很伤心。这引起了主角的注意，但她的注意力很快就转向了周围的人：突然转学到她学校的外国人、开始表现奇怪的姐姐以及她遇到的神秘女孩。当主角试图管理自己的个人生活时，在城市里，人们不断死亡。

[来自[url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=29&t=41308]Lemmasoft论坛[/url]]
